summary: Preserve the special rule that an ordinary constructor's explicit object return value replaces the allocated this object.

target.notes: After calling the constructor, return its result if that result is an Object; otherwise return the originally allocated receiver.

caveats: This differs fundamentally from C# constructors, which cannot replace the instance being constructed.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification [[Construct]] for ECMAScript Function Objects

tests.name: null return ignored
tests.input: function C(){this.x=1; return null}; console.log(new C().x);
